The dictionary-reference.tsv corpus was produced independently in Windows PowerShell 5 using .NET Framework Dictionary<int,int> (CLR Environment.Version 4.0.30319.42000), without invoking the original Pascal compiler. The C# probe and managed runtime are development tools and are not installed into the application.

System.Random(1729) drives 2048 add/set/remove/get/TryGetValue/ContainsKey/ContainsValue/Clear operations. Every row records operation, key, value, result or error, logical count and enumeration order. Keys span -32..32 and values -10000..10000. The native test checks all three outcomes per row directly, then generates one statically typed Pascal program from the same commands and compares its complete output. Its duplicate/missing-key guards preserve the corpus state; separate direct-runtime and Pascal error tests actually invoke the failing operations. No implementation-generated expected output is used.

The legacy contract was also checked against [Microsoft reference source Dictionary](https://github.com/microsoft/referencesource/blob/main/mscorlib/system/collections/generic/dictionary.cs): successful index replacement changes version, failed Remove does not, Clear depends on historical entries, and removed slots are reused from the free list. The modern .NET Dictionary permits some mutations during enumeration, so it was deliberately not used as the reference for those rules.

The original PABCSystem.pas supplies Dict/KV/Pair/fixed factories, Copy, Get/GetOrAdd, Each/EachCount, Update and dictionary operators. Their evaluation and nil behavior are tested separately. Concrete Dictionary/Keys/Values GetEnumerator is covered separately by dictionary-enumerators-reference.tsv; interface types, custom comparers and serialization are still pending; this fixture is not evidence that the full original library is complete.

Reproduction order for each row: draw key with Next(-32,33), then value with Next(-10000,10001), then kind with Next(0,8). Kinds 0..6 are Add, index assignment, Remove, index read, TryGetValue, ContainsKey and ContainsValue. Kind 7 performs Clear only when i % 19 == 0; otherwise it performs index assignment. After the operation, capture Count and enumerate key:value pairs in slot order. The sample starts with an empty dictionary and uses i=0..2047.

An empty enumeration is serialized as a single - in the last column, preserving six TSV fields without trailing whitespace. Tests decode that marker to an empty snapshot before comparing.
